readme: iOS App Store releases from the refactored-ios-version branch of ~/Desktop/personal/secondbrain. Shown as vertical markers on the console charts; tapping a tag opens the changelog. liveDate = date the final build of the version was pushed to the branch + 1 day (average App Store review time). Changes are written in plain product language for a non-technical reader: describe what changed for users (paywall, onboarding, features), not code internals. To add a release: prepend an entry (newest first) summarizing the commits since the previous version bump, then sync the copy in secondbrain-dashboard/viewer/ and push this site.

releases.title: Notes still get written when the AI has a bad day
changes: When the AI service behind note writing is slow or unavailable, the app now moves down to another version of it instead of failing your recording. You get the note, written slightly differently, rather than an error
Internal cleanup

releases.title: Fix for notes showing raw formatting
changes: Fixed notes that opened as plain text, showing symbols like ### and ** on screen with formatting buttons that did nothing. It affected about one note in five
Lines written one under the other, like the details of an appointment, now stay on separate lines while you edit
Email addresses, web links and links to your other notes are kept exactly as written
New notes are written in a format the app can always display and edit

releases.title: Notes you can edit like a document
changes: Notes are always editable: the edit button is gone, changes save on their own after you stop typing, and text is shown formatted instead of as raw symbols
Pro members can export every note as files, in one zip, from Settings
The app now works without a connection: notes and folders stay on screen and a thin bar says the connection is gone
Fixed quick voice recording from Back Tap and Control Center capturing nothing when the app was closed, and files shared into the app getting lost the same way
Fixed the calendar opening on the wrong day or staying empty until you switched view
Support address corrected to info@secondbrain.icu, plus a Settings link to the Claude and ChatGPT setup guide

releases.title: Paywall back to the proven design
changes: Paywall returned to the layout users responded to best: clear yearly price with the welcome discount, free-trial badge, and what Pro does for you
The yearly plan now also shows its per-month equivalent
Shorter onboarding: from your answers straight to your personalized offer
Clearer trial button: try SecondBrain Pro free, with the exact trial length shown
Declining the free trial now shows one clear confirmation: no payment today, cancel anytime

releases.title: Assistant reliability fixes
changes: Fixed a bug where the assistant could stay stuck on 'thinking' even after the answer was ready
Fixed voice recording sometimes not starting when the app was opened straight into quick record

releases.title: New paywall and glass design
changes: Completely redesigned paywall: growth charts, new glass look, yearly plan shown first
Paywall adapts the free-trial length automatically and is fully translated
New iOS 'Liquid Glass' look across the app, plus accessibility improvements
Voice notes are now always answered in the language you spoke, not the app language
Folder fixes: deleting a folder removes everything inside it, moved notes land in the right place, no more orphan notes
The assistant orb went back to the classic solid style

releases.title: Smarter trial offers
changes: The free-trial length shown on the paywall now adapts automatically to the offer
Paywall copy fully translated in every supported language

releases.title: Personalized onboarding
changes: New onboarding that asks who you are and what you need, then shows a paywall tailored to that persona with a dynamic offer
Onboarding questions rebuilt around real usage data
Fixed a paywall bug where an empty offer screen could appear
Free plan AI limit changed to 5 requests per day, 7 per week
Big internal cleanup to make future updates faster and less buggy (nothing visible to users)

releases.title: Better voice messages
changes: Record a voice message and attach a typed note, sent together in one tap
Voice messages can now last up to 2 minutes
Audio files can be shared into SecondBrain from other apps
Fixed photos and audio not loading right after opening the app, added a long-press menu on messages

releases.title: New animated onboarding
changes: Brand new animated onboarding on iPhone and Android, translated in every supported language (replaces the old static screenshots)
Fixed the AI sometimes writing notes in the wrong language

releases.title: Voice-first redesign
changes: The app became voice-first: redesigned assistant screen, new navigation with glass effect, new 3D loading animation
Share content from other apps straight into SecondBrain
Free plan set to 3 AI messages per day
Better notifications for urgent items and AI tasks
Lots of visual polish: assistant orb centering, lower tab bar, image previews in messages
